pr_title: Display correct mode when Ecobee via HomeKit is in vacation mode
pr_body:
Display correct mode when Ecobee is in vacation mode.

**Note that that Ecobee doesn't allow changing the current mode to vacation via HomeKit.**

I don't remember this one existing when the ecobee community did the original reverse engineering. And the behaviour between models seems to be erratic. So id like to be defensive here. At the very least, we should probably use minValue/maxValue here and clamp the supported values. There's a function that works on enums that can get you list of supported values, if you grep the integration for clamp_ I think you'll find it (sorry reviewing from phone).
And maybe reject any invalid values without writing them to the device?

issue_context.title: HomeKit Controller integration is missing 'vacation' mode for Ecobee thermostat
issue_context.body:
### The problem

My Ecobee reports that the valid values for current mode are 0 - 3.

```
{"iid":33,"type":"B7DDB9A3-54BB-4572-91D2-F1F5B0510F8C","format":"uint8","value":0,"perms":["pr"],"ev":false,"enc":false,"minValue":0,"maxValue":3,"minStep":1}
{"iid":40,"type":"1B300BC2-CFFC-47FF-89F9-BD6CCF5F2853","format":"uint8","perms":["pw"],"minValue":0,"maxValue":3,"minStep":1}
```

The following snippet from select.py show that the integration doesn't handle mode '3 - vacation'.

```
_ECOBEE_MODE_TO_TEXT = {
    0: "home",
    1: "sleep",
    2: "away",
}
```

While the Ecobee currently has a bug preventing proper reporting of the current mode, it should be possible to set the current mode to 'vacation'.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.8.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

Home Assistant OS

review_comments: Since vacation mode can't be set via HomeKit, this is really only useful for displaying the current mode (when it works). In order to display vacation mode, this line needs to include "vacation". But that also makes it an option to be selected. Is there a way to make it a display-only option?

The following lines added to `async_select_option` in this file would solve that, but it feels pretty kludgy.

```
        if option_int == 3:
            raise ValueError(f"Option {option} not valid for {self.entity_id}")
```
